bundle.shortDescription: PDF tools for very large jobs, running entirely on your own machine.
bundle.longDescription: ToolSeer Desktop processes jobs a browser tab cannot hold in memory - a thousand images or a seven-hundred page PDF. Work is streamed page by page to your own disk. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account and there is no telemetry.
